collectible.title: Momo's Matryoshka
collectible.subtitle: Her most treasured creation.
collectible.text: Momo's first flawless creation was a Russian matryoshka doll, which she was able to materialize at a very early age after several failed attempts. Because of this, she can generate endless amounts of matryoshka dolls based on her image almost instinctively.
collectible.unlock: Witness Momo use her Quirk to create something familiar.

collectible.title: Momo's Panties
collectible.subtitle: Never put on, but taken off once.
collectible.text: Momo left these after the game ended. She can always create more, so it doesn't seem like she needs them. They're as elegant and refined as she is.
